subject: ইংরেজি লিখিত
topic: Sentence Making with Idioms (২৫টি ক্লাসিক ইডিয়ম)
question:
নিচের ২৫টি বহুল প্রচলিত Idioms & Phrases-এর অর্থসহ অর্থপূর্ণ ইংরেজি বাক্য তৈরি করুন:
(1) At a loss (2) Apple of discord (3) Bone of contention (4) By leaps and bounds (5) In the long run (6) A black sheep (7) Maiden speech (8) Null and void (9) Once in a blue moon (10) To and fro (11) Cats and dogs (12) Hard and fast (13) Crocodile tears (14) Bed of roses (15) Blue blood (16) Burning question (17) Cock and bull story (18) Dark horse (19) End in smoke (20) Far and wide (21) Flesh and blood (22) For good (23) In a nutshell (24) Red letter day (25) Up and downs
answer:
1. At a loss (হতবুদ্ধি): He was at a loss and did not know what to do.
2. Apple of discord (বিবাদের বিষয়): The paternal property is the apple of discord between the brothers.
3. Bone of contention (বিরোধের কারণ): The border issue is the main bone of contention between both nations.
4. By leaps and bounds (দ্রুত গতিতে): ICT literacy in Bangladesh is advancing by leaps and bounds.
5. In the long run (পরিণামে): Honesty will be rewarded in the long run.
6. A black sheep (কুলাঙ্গার): Every family has a black sheep.
7. Maiden speech (প্রথম বক্তৃতা): His maiden speech impressed everyone in the assembly.
8. Null and void (বাতিল): The illegal agreement was declared null and void by the court.
9. Once in a blue moon (কদাচিৎ): He visits our village home once in a blue moon.
10. To and fro (এদিক-ওদিক): The worried father was walking to and fro in the corridor.
11. Cats and dogs (মুষলধারে): It was raining cats and dogs all afternoon.
12. Hard and fast (বাঁধাধরা): There are no hard and fast rules in this matter.
13. Crocodile tears (মায়াকান্না): Do not believe her, she is only shedding crocodile tears.
14. Bed of roses (পুষ্পশয্যা বা সহজ জীবন): Life is not a bed of roses.
15. Blue blood (আভিজাত্য): Though he boasts of blue blood, he is ill-mannered.
16. Burning question (জরুরি আলোচ্য বিষয়): Price hike of daily essentials is a burning question today.
17. Cock and bull story (আজগুবি গল্প): Nobody believed his cock and bull story about missing the train.
18. Dark horse (অপ্রত্যাশিত বিজয়ী): The quiet student turned out to be a dark horse in the exam.
19. End in smoke (ব্যর্থতায় পর্যবসিত হওয়া): All his grand plans ended in smoke.
20. Far and wide (সর্বত্র): His fame as an ICT instructor spread far and wide.
21. Flesh and blood (রক্তমাংসের শরীর): Human flesh and blood cannot tolerate such injustice.
22. For good (চিরতরে): He left the city for good.
23. In a nutshell (সংক্ষেপে): Explain the whole project in a nutshell.
24. Red letter day (স্মরণীয় দিন): 26th March is a red letter day in our history.
25. Ups and downs (উত্থান-পতন): Everyone must face ups and downs in life.
tips: বাক্য সহজ ও গ্রামাটিক্যালি সঠিক রাখবেন, বেশি জটিল করতে গিয়ে ভুল করবেন না।
